After an unusually long three-week wait, Apple today finally released iOS 27 beta 5, bringing a brand-new icon design to several apps including Siri and Safari.

Apple redesigns app icons in iOS 27 beta 5

iOS 27 is getting closer to its official launch, expected next month.

This beta 5 includes a number of user-visible changes, paving the way for the official release.

Among them, several built-in apps have received new icons:

  • Siri
  • Safari
  • Preview
  • Settings
  • Remote

You can see some of the new icons in the image above, and other apps have also received minor updates.

Since the first beta, iOS 27 has been gradually adjusting its icon design, as Apple continues to refine last year's Liquid Glass aesthetic.

Since the iOS 27 beta testing began, apps including Maps, Photos and Wallet have already received new icons one after another. However, the changes in beta 5 show that Apple has not yet finished the icon adjustment work for iOS 27.

What do you think of the latest app icon changes in iOS 27? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
